A reported negative result is an outcome, not missing. List ambiguities. Return only the required structured response. Extract only in-vivo experiments and outcomes for hepatocytes in NP-002. Preserve MC3 versus cKK-E12 formulation identity, QUANT-DNA biodistribution versus Cre-mRNA functional delivery, dose, route, timepoint, assay, and comparators. Do not infer other cell types.
